subject: Private Deployment: Architecture Review & Site Constraints
content:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@atlasbank.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 15:32:00 -0800
Subject: Private Deployment: Architecture Review & Site Constraints

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the call earlier. As discussed, the next step is a focused architecture review (45–60 minutes) to walk through Atlas Bank's VPC/on-prem constraints and to validate network, KMS, and air-gap requirements before we proceed with a proof-of-concept.

Proposed agenda (draft):
- 10 min: goals & scope (customer)
- 20–30 min: topology deep-dive (VPC peering, routing, firewall rules, proxies)
- 10 min: security controls (KMS, HSM options, audit logging)
- 10 min: deployment models & next steps (dedicated vs private, timelines)

Suggested times (PST):
- Tue Jan 12, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Jan 13, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Jan 14, 09:00–10:00

Quick asks before the call:
- Please confirm which Atlas teams will join (networking, security, infra).
- Attach any network diagrams or ACL lists if available (I attached a short checklist we use).
- If you require an NDA or additional compliance paperwork prior to deep-dive, flag it now.

Attachments: redwood_private_deploy_checklist.xlsx (deployment checklist & sample agenda)

Looking forward — happy to move times if needed.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
---

> Hi Rachel,
>
> Thanks — we definitely want to move forward with a technical review. The people who should join from our side are:
> - Samantha Lee (cloud security)
> - Atlas Bank Ops (ops-eng@atlasbank.com) — will include our infra lead
> - We may also include a representative from procurement (TBD)
>
> The Tue/Wed slots conflict with an external audit. Could we do Fri Jan 15 in the morning (EST), or Mon Jan 18? Our bandwidth is limited next week.
>
> Also, we prefer a separate section on air-gapped deployments — our compliance team flagged a few environment constraints.
>
> Cheers,
> Samantha
> Director, Cloud Security
> Atlas Bank

>
> New suggested slots (all PST):

> - Mon Jan 18, 09:00–10:00 (Mon afternoon EST)
>

>

>
> If those times look good I'll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read.

>
> Best,
> Rachel

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 11:16:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Private Deployment: Architecture Review & Site Constraints

Hi Samantha — quick note from our engineering side:

If Mon Jan 18 works, we'd like to cover these specific technical items (10–15 min each):
- network egress controls and NAT/transit gateway patterns
- KMS/HSM integration options (bring your KMS team if possible)
- prefix caching & KV cache persistence for private instances
- bandwidth/throughput expectations and suggested instance sizing

We'll draft a brief runbook and share it prior to the meeting. If you have any corporate firewall appliances that do TLS interception, please let us know so we can advise on certificate handling.

-Markus
